messages:
Rachel: Post-call notes from the EU FinReg pilot. They pushed hard on 3 items that affect our roadmap/pricing:
1) region-aware retention buckets (EU data must stay in-region for 3y by default)
2) signed cryptographic proofs for audit exports (they want a verifiable Merkle-root per export)
3) a formal e-discovery SLA of 5 business days with evidence chaining
We need product input on whether to treat region-retention and signed-proofs as core Enterprise or paid add-ons.

Tom: Important nuance: region-aware retention means different lifecycle policies and possibly separate cold buckets per region. That has infra cost and increases cross-region restore complexity.

Sofia: On signed proofs: we can emit a Merkle root and signature at export time. Minimal design: compute root over exported records, sign with a platform key, and include the signature + public key metadata in the export package. Will coordinate with security for key management.

Kenji: Engineering note: Implementation pieces:
- per-tenant retention-mask mapping (region->retention-days)
- export pipeline step: build Merkle tree, sign root, attach proof file
- audit ledger entry with immutable timestamped record
Estimate: spike 1 week, Phase 1 (Merkle proofs + export wrapper) 3 sprints, region retention changes 2-3 sprints more.

Liam: Compliance asks to map these to SOC2 and ISO controls. If we promise signed proofs we must add tests proving signature validity, key rotation handling, and proof reproducibility. Also need to document key custody (customer vs Redwood).

legal-bot: Flag: if customers want customer-managed keys for signing exports, that triggers BYOK escrow conversation and extra legal terms.

Rachel: Product options to propose to pilot:
A) Include in Enterprise: region retention + signed proofs. Higher list price, simpler packaging.
B) Enterprise base includes region retention only; signed proofs sold as an \"Evidence Integrity\" add-on (per-export fee).
C) Core platform covers basic export; both region retention and signed proofs are add-ons.
We should pick one and present it to the pilot by EOW.

Tom: Ops impact: region retention requires new monitoring/alerts for cross-region data drift and a preflight check on restores to ensure regional constraints aren't violated. Also billing: must surface regional storage delta in invoices.

Sofia: Security question: who signs the proof? Options:
- Redwood-sign: fast, simpler key lifecycle, but customers ask for verifiable separation
- Customer-sign (BYOK): stronger guarantee but large engineering + legal lift
We could offer Redwood-sign by default and a paid BYOK-signing option.

Kenji: API sketch for export with proof (for design doc):
POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/exports?region=eu-west-1&proof=true
Body: { \"from\": \"2025-11-01\", \"to\": \"2026-03-01\", \"format\": \"jsonl\" }
Response: 202 Accepted
{ \"export_id\": \"exp-20260310-01\", \"status\": \"queued\", \"proof_expected\": true }

Rachel: Add fields: signed_by, signature_alg, signature_blob_url in final manifest. Also include merkle_tree_size and canonicalization method.

Liam: SOC2 mapping notes to include in spike: replicable verification steps, test harness to recompute root, and rota tests for key rotation. Add to C-9015.

Kenji: Quick tradeoff calc I ran: signed-proofs engineering cost ~6-8 dev-weeks; region-retention infra changes ~4-6 dev-weeks. If we bundle both into Enterprise it'll push other Q next features.

Rachel: Proposal: present Option B to pilot: include region retention in Enterprise; signed proofs as Evidence Integrity add-on with Redwood-sign by default. If customer anchors with revenue or insists on BYOK signing, put BYOK-signing into a paid expedited path.

Tom: I vote B. Less product risk and clear monetization.

Sofia: I second B. We'll scope the spike to validate Merkle computation perf on large exports (10M rows).

ops-bot: Ticket created: C-9015 \"spike: export signing + region-retention impact\" assigned to Kenji. Due 2026-03-25.

Rachel: Action items: Kenji to run spike and return perf numbers; Liam to draft SOC2/ISO mapping for proofs; finance to model pricing uplift for Evidence Integrity add-on. Present recommendation in Tuesday sync.

Kenji: Starting spike Monday. Will post interim findings in the thread.

Rachel: Thanks team. We'll lock packaging decision after spike. :calendar:
